title: Sky Lab brightness explorer
enhancements: Replaced the static magnitude panel with linked apparent-magnitude and received-light diagrams.
Added Sun, Sirius and Vega reference examples using named published V-band measurements.
Made intrinsic brightness, distance and foreground dust independent controls with keyboard and touch support.
Added readable phone figures, source tables, model limits and a Stars page shortcut.
Preserved unrelated saved investigations and recovered malformed restored input.

assumptions: Steady nearby point source; Euclidean inverse-square dilution.
Inferred catalogue M_V assumes negligible extinction for these nearby examples.
Foreground A_V is a separately chosen V-band dimming, not a fixed per-distance dust rate.
Quoted parallax errors are shown; measurement and calibration uncertainty are not propagated.
V-band luminosity ratios compare one filter and do not replace bolometric luminosity.
